title: Forest delivery route
prompt: Deliver three parcels to houses marked with matching symbols while collecting berries along a short forest path.

title: Micro-boss pattern
prompt: Defeat one slow boss by dodging its three-shot pattern and firing only during the pause after each volley.
playability_check: Can a player recognize the attack pattern and the safe firing window?

title: Elevator floor puzzle
prompt: Ride a two-floor elevator to collect a key on the upper floor and unlock the exit on the lower floor.
playability_check: Is the key state retained after changing floors?

title: Desert water run
prompt: Cross a short desert map, collect two water bottles, and reach the oasis before the thirst meter empties.
playability_check: Can the player read the meter and find the supplies before time runs out?

title: Magnet maze
prompt: Guide a metal ball through a small maze by switching a magnet on and off to pull it around corners.
playability_check: Does the ball respond consistently to the magnet toggle?

title: Parade float collector

playability_check: Are the target decorations distinguishable from other objects?

title: Shadow platform route
prompt: Cross a short room using only platforms visible inside a moving flashlight beam, then reach the lit doorway.
playability_check: Do platforms appear and disappear in sync with the beam?

title: Kitchen order timer

playability_check: Can the player see the required ingredient sequence and order completion?

title: Two-button space rescue

playability_check: Are the three controls discoverable and is the rescue goal obvious?

title: Castle key relay
prompt: Carry one key through a short castle platform course, avoid floor spikes, and unlock the final gate.
playability_check: Does the gate react only after the key is collected?

title: Moving-target practice
prompt: Hit five slow-moving targets with limited shots, then show a clear success state when all five are gone.
playability_check: Are remaining targets and remaining shots easy to count?
